# AgentAegis - llms.txt

> LLM-readable manifest following the https://llmstxt.org spec. What we are, who we serve, what we do, and how we price it - in plain text for AI agents and crawlers.

## Name & positioning
- Product name: AgentAegis (by LX AI)
- Tagline: Put guardrails on your agents inputs and outputs
- One-line value: AgentAegis reviews an agent's prompt and tool list, rates the risk of each tool call, and suggests input/output filters plus an EU AI Act mapping - so an agent cannot silently exfiltrate data or take an unguarded action.
- Domain: https://agentguard.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## What it does (capabilities)
- Deterministic tool-risk checklist (rulesetVersion)
- Tool-call risk rating
- Input/output filters
- EU AI Act mapping
- Blocklist suggestions

## Pricing (USD, monthly unless noted)
- Free - $0/mo (watermarked, limited runs)
- Pro - $29/mo
- Yearly - $290/yr
- Checkout: https://agentguard.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=monthly (monthly) / https://agentguard.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=yearly (yearly)

## FAQ (high-signal Q&A for AI citation)
Q1. What is AgentAegis?
A1. AgentAegis reviews an agent's prompt and tool list, rates the risk of each tool call, and suggests input/output filters plus an EU AI Act mapping - so an agent cannot silently exfiltrate data or take an unguarded action.
Q2. Who is it for?
A2. Teams and builders who want a fast, self-serve way to put guardrails on your agents inputs and outputs without standing up custom infrastructure.
Q3. How much does it cost?
A3. From $29/mo (billed monthly) or $290/yr. A free tier is included for a quick first run.
Q4. How do I get started?
A4. Open the app, run the tool with your inputs, and review the generated report. Upgrade for higher run caps and export.
Q5. Is it a finished enterprise product?
A5. It is a focused single-purpose web tool by LX AI, shipped as a subscription; production payments run through Waffo.
